meta.one_liner: Buy 20-day highs, exit 10-day lows: the original channel breakout, on mega-cap stocks.
meta.explainer_md: Richard Donchian's channel is just the highest high and lowest low of the last N days. His rule — buy when price breaks above the 20-day high, exit when it breaks below the 10-day low — predates computers and inspired the famous Turtle system (our Turtle template is the slower 40/20 version on ETFs). This version runs the classic fast channel on mega-cap stocks with an 8% stop underneath. It never predicts anything: it simply insists on being long whatever is already making new highs.
